title: Learning Nonlinear Waveform Fusion Across Scales for Integrated Sensing and Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.32099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fixed source superposition and frequency partitioning constrain how communication content interacts with a probing reference in integrated sensing and communication (ISAC). We learn nonlinear waveform fusion across scales for image transmission and localization of multiple targets in range and angle. Reception uses the information available at each end. Adaptive temporal feature weighting and spectral updates combine image features and a deterministic linearly frequency-modulated reference in a shared complex state, generating a waveform with fixed total energy over the array frame. At the user equipment (UE), the reference and channel state information condition a neural demixer for image reconstruction. At the base station, the realized transmit pulse defines a coherent dictionary for sequential localization with learned local correction, physical refinement, and residual updates. translated_title: 面向通感一体化的跨尺度非线性波形融合学习
translated_abstract: 固定的源信号叠加与频率划分方式限制了通感一体化中通信内容与探测参考信号之间的相互作用。我们学习跨尺度的非线性波形融合方法，用于图像传输以及多个目标在距离和角度上的定位。接收端利用各自可用的信息。自适应的时间特征加权和频谱更新将图像特征与确定性的线性调频参考信号结合在共享的复数状态中，生成在阵列帧上具有固定总能量的波形。在用户设备（UE）处，参考信号和信道状态信息对神经解混器进行条件化以实现图像重建。在基站处，实际发射的脉冲定义了一个相干字典，用于通过学习的局部校正、物理细化和残差更新进行序贯定位。我们将所提出的波形与叠加方法进行比较……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种跨尺度非线性波形融合的学习方法，通过自适应时间特征加权与频谱更新，将图像特征与线性调频参考信号融合于共享复数状态并保持固定总能量，从而在通感一体化系统中同时实现图像传输与多目标的距离-角度定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a learned nonlinear cross-scale waveform fusion method that adaptively combines image features with a deterministic linear frequency-modulated reference in a shared complex state under fixed total energy, jointly enabling image transmission and multi-target range-angle localization in integrated sensing and communication systems.
